camel_example: aliyun oceanbasepro ModifyInstanceSSL --region cn-hangzhou --EnableSSL open --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000
description_en: Modifies the SSL configuration of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改实例的 SSL 配置
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro modify-instance-ssl --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --enable-ssl open --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceSSL

parameters.help_en: The ID of the OceanBase instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The action to perform on the SSL configuration. Valid values:

`open`: Enable SSL encryption.

`update`: Update the CA certificate.

`close`: Disable SSL encryption
parameters.help_zh:
修改 SSL 状态，取值范围：
open：开启 SSL 加密。
update：更新 CA 证书。
close：关闭 SSL 加密
parameters.name: enable_ssl

InstanceSSL.description_en: The SSL configuration of the OceanBase instance
InstanceSSL.description_zh: OceanBase 实例的 SSL 配置

EnableSSL.description_en:
The SSL encryption status. Valid values:

`open`: SSL encryption is enabled.

`update`: The CA certificate is being updated.

`close`: SSL encryption is disabled
EnableSSL.description_zh:
修改 SSL 状态，取值范围：
open：开启 SSL 加密。
update：更新 CA 证书。
close：关闭 SSL 加密
